filename: Great Papers 12 - The Dirac Equation and Antimatter, 1928.mp3
paper_title: The Quantum Theory of the Electron
summary: The podcast discusses Paul Dirac's 1928 paper where he reconciled quantum mechanics and special relativity, leading to the Dirac Equation. This equation unexpectedly predicted electron spin and the existence of antimatter (specifically, the positron), which was later experimentally confirmed.
